name: Abner
overview: Abner, the son of Ner and cousin to King Saul, served as the captain of Saul's army, demonstrating his prominent role in the house of Saul (1 Samuel 14:50-51). Scripture highlights his leadership in military matters and his close association with Saul, as seen when Saul consults Abner regarding David (1 Samuel 17:55) and when Abner is present with Saul during critical moments (1 Samuel 26:5,14). His story reflects themes of loyalty and conflict within Saul's house, culminating in his tragic death and the sorrow it brought to David.
